targets.name: boot_logos
targets.title: Boot logos
targets.description: The first screens at power on, The Pokémon Company's and Nintendo's logos, which a button skips (src/ov162/boot_screens.c). Both screens share one sheet of tiles.

targets.name: copyright
targets.title: Copyright notice
targets.description: The black screen of copyright lines after the boot logos (src/ov162/boot_screens.c). The end of the credits shows the top screen again in palette row 2's colors (src/ov266/staff_roll_main.c), and rows 1 and 2 are the credits' Japanese copyright screens', so the art keeps to the other rows.

targets.name: boot_extra
targets.title: Screen after the copyright
targets.description: Paper White 2's own boot screen, after the copyright notice, which A, B or Start skips (src/ov162/boot_screens.c). While its palette is all black it is skipped, so it stays off until it has art.

targets.name: title_logo
targets.title: Title screen logo
targets.description: The title screen's logo and the streaks scrolling behind it, in 256 colors, which share a sheet of tiles and the palette (src/ov162/title.c). The end of the credits shows the logo too (src/ov266/staff_roll_main.c).

targets.name: title_top
targets.title: Title screen, other screen
targets.description: The title screen's other display, behind the 3D Pokémon, with "Developed by GAME FREAK inc." (src/ov162/title.c).

targets.name: pokedex_info_stats
targets.title: Pokédex Info: Stats
targets.description: The bottom screen of the Pokédex's Info page on its Stats sub-page, under the page's text, bars and buttons and over the grid (src/paperwhite2/ov298/paperwhite2_pokedex_info_panels.c): sub BG 6 in palette row 6, which the buttons share. Its source is res/paperwhite2/pokedex_art/info_stats.png, drawn over tools/paperwhite2/pokedex_templates.py's templates.

targets.name: pokedex_info_data
targets.title: Pokédex Info: Data
targets.description: The bottom screen of the Pokédex's Info page on its Data sub-page, under the page's text and over the grid (src/paperwhite2/ov298/paperwhite2_pokedex_info_panels.c): sub BG 6 in palette row 7. Its source is res/paperwhite2/pokedex_art/info_data.png, drawn over tools/paperwhite2/pokedex_templates.py's templates.

targets.name: pokedex_info_moves
targets.title: Pokédex Info: Moves
targets.description: The bottom screen of the Pokédex's Info page on its Moves sub-page: its tab strip and the sets' bar, under the page's text, rows and cursor and over the grid (src/paperwhite2/ov298/paperwhite2_pokedex_info_panels.c): sub BG 6 in palette row 8. Its source is res/paperwhite2/pokedex_art/info_moves.png.

targets.name: pokedex_move_panel
targets.title: Pokédex Info: move panel
targets.description: The panel of a move's data over the top screen of the Pokédex's Info page, opened from the Moves sub-page (src/paperwhite2/ov298/paperwhite2_pokedex_move_panel.c): its tiles on main BG 1 beside the head bar's and the text's, so few distinct ones fit outside the text boxes, where the art is drawn into the boxes behind the text. Its source is res/paperwhite2/pokedex_art/move_panel.png.

targets.name: pokedex_info_evo
targets.title: Pokédex Info: Evo
targets.description: The bottom screen of the Pokédex's Info page on its Evo sub-page, under the page's text and over the grid (src/paperwhite2/ov298/paperwhite2_pokedex_info_panels.c): sub BG 6 in palette row 9. Its source is res/paperwhite2/pokedex_art/info_evo.png.

targets.name: pokedex_info_matchups
targets.title: Pokédex Info: Matchups
targets.description: The bottom screen of the Pokédex's Info page on its Matchups sub-page, under the page's text and over the grid (src/paperwhite2/ov298/paperwhite2_pokedex_info_panels.c): sub BG 6 in palette row 10. Its source is res/paperwhite2/pokedex_art/info_matchups.png.
